$comment: System-wide fight rules measured out of Street Fighter II: Champion Edition by tools/sf2-probe (see research/rom/sf2ce/system.json for the raw readings); written by tools/sf2-probe/derive/adopt.mjs. Arcade pixels, 60Hz frames, health 144.

defence.$comment: Which school of defence is in force. See research/BUILDER.md: the three arcade boards measured give three different answers, and this is the switch between them. 'hold-away' is Champion Edition and Third Strike; 'auto-standing' is Tekken 3, where doing nothing guards highs and mids; 'guard-button' is Virtua Fighter 2, where guard is a button that also roots you to the floor.
